target.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS Control tab used a bordered header/manage-gateway row, section header labels, and flat list-row icons — feature request #98283 asked for a flatter, card-based layout.

## Why This Change Was Made

Promote Chat/Talk to two prominent cards, drop the bordered header/manage-gateway row and section header labels, and switch list-row icons to solid gradient circles with taller rows, per the redesign requested in #98283.

## User Impact

Visual-only change to the iOS Control tab: flatter hierarchy, more prominent Chat/Talk entry points, larger touch targets on list rows. No behavior/API change.

## Evidence

- `RootTabsSourceGuardTests` (source-guard test suite) passes: `xcodebuild test -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsSourceGuardTests` — 30/30 passed.
- Included a follow-up fix to `RootTabsSourceGuardTests.swift` updating a stale source-guard assertion (`gatewayActionRow` -> `headerCard`) that the redesign's rename otherwise left failing.

Closes #98283
